scope: Actual local weighted first coarea derivative and global finite domination only. Gamma derivative exchange, mixture assembly and the final signed trace rate remain separate.

RectangleCLTArxivV1.continuousAt_weighte.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.continuousAt_weighted_gaussianFiniteThreshold_of_slack
RectangleCLTArxivV1.continuousAt_weighte.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ} (s : Finset (Fin m)) (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m),
  (∀ j ∈ s, u j ≠ 0 ∨ b j ≠ 0) →
    ∀ (f : RectangleCLT.Vector r → ℝ),
      Measurable f →
        MeasureTheory.Integrable f (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) →
          ContinuousAt
            (fun c =>
              ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianFiniteThresholdEvent s u c).indicator f
                  g ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r)
            b

  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1 →
    ∀ (c₀ : ℝ),
      (∀ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j,
          RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianNormalProjection (u j) (u l) ≠ 0 ∨
            b l - c₀ * RectangleCLT.faceDot (u l) (u j) ≠ 0) →
        ContinuousAt (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.thresholdSignedSection u b j) c₀

RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianThresholdAbs.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianThresholdAbsoluteFaceTrace_update_eq_section_integral
RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianThresholdAbs.expanded_type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (j : Fin m),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1 →
    ∀ (c : ℝ),
      RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianThresholdAbsoluteFaceTrace u (Function.update b j c) j =
